description: HTTP caching audit (Cache-Control, CDN, ETag, 304) — Audit how a URL is cached: parses Cache-Control/Expires into browser and shared-cache TTLs, detects the CDN and its HIT/MISS status (Cloudflare, Fastly, CloudFront, Akamai, Vercel, Netlify, Azure), checks ETag/Last-Modified and actually sends a conditional request to confirm a 304, flags Vary problems, cacheable responses that set cookies, short TTLs on static or versioned assets, long browser TTLs on HTML and missing compression. Returns an A-F grade, score and fixes. Param: url= (page or asset). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: web_cache_check
